loadgen_defect.symptom: Rare malformed Conversation JSON reads appeared only with multiple record processors.
loadgen_defect.observed_mechanism: AIPerf 0.12 MemoryMapDatasetClient.get_conversation calls seek(offset) followed by read(size) on one shared mmap object without synchronization.
loadgen_defect.correction: Use one record processor per client and double client count while returning from the 2x trace to the original trace, preserving 6053.07 aggregate offered RPS.

limitations: Only AIPerf summary exports were configured, so global request-level percentiles cannot be recomputed from raw JSONL.
The clean CPU-ceiling series changes client decomposition from the topology series; comparisons between those series are absolute context only.
Mock workers measure orchestration capacity, not GPU inference capacity.
No empirical n=3 noise-floor pilot was run; small clean-series deltas are treated cautiously.
